title: Wildheart site rebuilt top to bottom from the design handoff: the fixed chrome, the pinned year journey, the sky map, every screen's sections and every word of the template

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-13: 'Make sure the site is identical to the design system files, and tied in with all the Frequency blocks. Do 5 design passes and get every detail for wildheart.academy worked out.' Then: 'The design system was already supposed to be built into a template. Use every bit of content from the design system to propagate wildheart.academy.' Then: 'Let's do a top to bottom redesign from the Design System handoff.'

detail:
The live site after LIVE-903 was the handoff's palette on a generic composition: a narrow page, the headline at half the display size, a small arch, a generic Space header, the year journey as three sign cards, flat cards, a retreat band inside the column, an events list and the generic footer with an admin pill. The owner's second handoff (design_handoff_wildheart, 2026-10-13: a full-bleed page with a centred 1216px column, a fixed header with a 116px spacer and no auto-hide, the YearJourney rebuilt as a pinned scroll-scrubbed wheel, the footer's three columns and 'A program on Frequency', the four home icons embedded) is now the site, section by section, in five screenshot-proven passes (scripts/probes/wildheart-shots.mjs beside the handoff's own screens, which this sandbox could now render by vendoring React and Babel).

CHROME (components/sites/site-chrome.tsx, house-header.tsx, wildheart-now-line.tsx, site-member-badge.tsx, site-admin-bar.tsx): on this theme the header is a fixed bar with the date line under it and a 116px spacer; the mark is WhLogoMark (components/sites/wildheart-symbols.tsx: the handoff's LogoMark, the figure's paths once per page as a symbol in WildheartInkDefs, the WILD / HEART wordmark from the Space's own name through wordmarkLines, lockups and tones), horizontal at 46px in the header, stacked at 170px in the footer and at 360px in twilight on About; the six nav labels in 12px tracked caps with the violet underline; the Admin chip in nightshade naming the same two admin pages Vision and Calendar (siteAdminNavLinks takes the theme); the membership island as the account pill; the sub-bar reads 'Next Circle Night' from the Space's next Circle Night and folds after 40px of scroll through a scroll timeline; the footer draws the Space's own words from preferences.siteFooter (lib/sites/site-footer.ts: columns, a blurb under the mark, the closing line, a phone note, the copyright suffix linked to Frequency), resolved to the site's pages by siteFooterFor. The Space's header button and the footer's admin section are not in the handoff and the skin hides them.

BLOCKS (components/page-editor/blocks/wildheart.tsx): WildheartYearJourney is the pinned wheel (components/sites/wildheart-year-journey.tsx, a client island: runway, sticky stage, fourteen curated stops from the sky and the Space's events with the theme's teaching lines, one rAF loop writing transforms to refs, drag with momentum, tilt and glow, arrow keys, the rail, reduced motion exact); WildheartSkyMap is the click-driven wheel (components/sites/wildheart-sky-map.tsx: the zodiac wheel turning the short way round, scope and group filters, the season track, the constellation, centered at 440 on The year and compact at 340 on a phone's Home); WildheartModules (twelve cards with data-season), WildheartFirstNight (the four-way 'how would you like to arrive' choice, every note in the page, hidden until picked); the season band gained the Circle Night time range, a line after the module now, 'Next rituals' and a constellation; the moon path numbers in roman and links; the mark split draws the mark. Core blocks gained the fields the handoff's sections need: PhotoHero a line under the buttons, AccentBeat a second button and a plain background, SpaceCommunity a grid shape with a seat noun, SpacePractices an 'only' filter; the shared renderer (components/sites/menswork-page.tsx) draws a list of 'P · Presence · line' items as the five beats inside a story, a circle grid, the week's focus line from the journey phase's body (lib/sites/menswork-data.ts), a block's own visibility, the four Lucide icons. The sky engine reads the sign at the end of the UTC day so an ingress day counts as the new sign whatever the hour (lib/theme/astrology-wheel.ts). The Space's festivals and moons listed as events merge with the sky's own items (kind and phase from the sky, title, note and link from the row).

SEED (scripts/seed-wildheart.mts, scripts/seed-wildheart.sql regenerated): the six page docs are the handoff's screens top to bottom with the handoff's words, plus the phone's Home through the blocks' visibility field; event titles and notes are the handoff's calendar ('Week 1 · Arriving', "Hunter's Moon" / 'Full moon esbat · release', 'Lughnasadh', the two enrollment days); the primary circle is 'Primary Circle' (Central) and three local circles (Eastside, Foothills, Riverside) are seeded as real rows with their areas, nights and notes; preferences.siteFooter carries the footer. scripts/probes/wildheart-content.mjs extracts every string of the handoff template into scripts/probes/wildheart-content-checklist.json (370 strings over the chrome, the six screens, the phone and the components' labels, with the template's placeholders excepted by name); the render harness (test/wildheart-site.render.test.tsx) renders the six pages and fails when one is missing; the probe checks the same list against the seed, the rows and the theme's labels (a probe cannot render JSX, LIVE-475), the few lines composed from a date at render time named.

SKIN (components/sites/wildheart-css.ts): the handoff's layout rules section by section (the column, 96px gaps, the hero scale, the bridge, the pinned stage, the parts, the path, the season band, the beats tiles, the pillars, the full-bleed band, the plain closing row and the lavender invitation, the foundation head and week cards, the practice and care cards, the sky map and zodiac wheel, the module cards, the circle grid, the mark, the first night, the phone). Theme CSS 155,131 bytes; the budget in the probe rises from 128KB to 160KB for the two interactive pieces. Tokens only.

KNOWN GAPS against the handoff: the phone hero has no date line between the photo and the headline; the retreat hero's kicker glyph is the moon, not Scorpio; the nav does not shorten its labels under 1180px; the admin pages (Vision, Calendar) keep the Menswork skin; the account pill's 'View as' switcher is the mock's (Frequency reads the real role); seat counts and hosts on the circle cards are the rows' (the harness shows the handoff's numbers). The LIVE-903 probe's three stale premises (a four-block minimum, an events list on Home and Retreat, the 128KB budget) follow the handoff; the row is untouched. Follow-up 2026-10-13 (owner's About screenshot): the live render passes the website content, whose name sits under identity, so the About mark card drew nothing; the block now reads identity.name first and the harness mirrors that shape. Tailwind's preflight makes every svg a block, so the date line's moon sat above its label ('Waxing crescent' on a second line); the moon part is a nowrap flex row and the moon inline.
